description.value: Seymour's Pub is a community neighbourhood pub on North Vancouver's Old Lillooet Road, known for homemade food made from scratch daily — including all sauces and dressings — alongside 22 beers on draught spanning local craft, domestic, and international selections. Fifteen TV screens make it a reliable spot to catch major sporting events, while live music on select Fridays and a DJ every Saturday night give it an energetic evening atmosphere. A twice-daily happy hour and rotating daily food specials make it a well-established local gathering point on the North Shore.
